_meta.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#000.src: You should put the mask on before you leave.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#000.dst: 떠나기 전에 가면을 쓰는 게 좋겠어.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#000.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#001.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.src: Oh, ho ho. What is this? A Human? What brings you to Gylia Watch - want to let your hair down a bit, I bet!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.dst: 오, 호호. 이게 뭐야? 인간? Gylia Watch엔 무슨 일로 왔어? 좀 놀다 가려는 거지, 그렇지!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.src: Of course you know who we are! The Gylia Watch was founded over {~} years ago in wake of the Villager victory in the war.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.dst: 당연히 우리가 누군지 알겠지! Gylia Watch는 {~}년도 더 전에 주민들이 전쟁에서 이긴 뒤 세워졌어.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.src: The Gerten war! Only the most famous war in all of modern Gavel! The might of the Villagers crushed those blasted Gerts - not that they were particularly hard to beat, heh.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.dst: Gerten 전쟁! 현대 Gavel에서 제일 유명한 전쟁이지! 주민들의 힘이 그 빌어먹을 Gert들을 짓밟았어. 뭐, 딱히 어려운 상대도 아니었지만, 헤.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.src: Gerts are stupid brutes, you see. The only thing they ever think about is food.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.dst: 알다시피 Gert는 멍청한 짐승들이야. 머릿속엔 오로지 먹을 것뿐이지.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.src: Get too close to one and it'll chomp your fingers off, quick as you like. And then the rest of you as well!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.dst: 너무 가까이 가면 손가락을 눈 깜짝할 새 뜯어 먹어. 그다음엔 나머지 몸도!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.src: The peace treaty keeps them inside their borders, and we get a delivery of supplies every month from {p} to send over to them.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.dst: 평화 조약으로 놈들은 국경 안에 갇혀 있고, 우린 매달 {p}에서 물자를 받아 놈들한테 보내 줘.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.src: Of course, we have to keep some of the supplies for ourselves - you've seen how hard these men are working, they deserve a bit of a party!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.dst: 물론 물자 일부는 우리 몫으로 챙겨야지. 여기 사람들 얼마나 고생하는지 봤잖아, 파티 좀 할 자격은 있다고!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.src: The Watch keeps a lookout over the Gerten borders day and night... well, maybe not on poker nights!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.dst: 경비대는 밤낮으로 Gerten 국경을 감시해... 뭐, 포커 치는 밤은 빼고!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.src: Although... we have heard a couple of nasty rumors floating about - farmers disappearing from their houses and the such.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.dst: 그런데... 흉흉한 소문이 좀 돌더라고. 농부들이 집에서 사라진다든가 하는.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.src: If I really can't tempt you with a glass of wine and a round of poker, maybe you could go and check them out for us?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.dst: 와인 한 잔이랑 포커 한 판으로도 못 꼬시겠다면, 대신 가서 좀 알아봐 줄래?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.src: I'd send the men, but... well, I'd feel bad if one of them went and missed all the partying!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.dst: 우리 애들을 보낼 수도 있지만... 그러다 누가 파티를 놓치면 미안하잖아!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.src: Here, you should head over and talk to Jitak, they're one of the farmers that lodged a complaint. Their house is west of here, I'll write down the co-ordinates.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.dst: 자, Jitak한테 가서 얘기해 봐. 민원을 넣은 농부 중 하나야. 집이 여기서 서쪽인데, 좌표 적어 줄게.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#014.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.src: If you are looking for a suit or something, I can't help you. Now is a very bad time.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.dst: 옷 같은 걸 찾으러 왔다면 도와줄 수 없어. 지금은 정말 때가 안 좋아.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.src: Oh, you're here on behalf of the Watch? Ha, even sending Humans to do their work is not beneath them.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.dst: 아, 경비대 대신 왔다고? 하, 인간한테 자기 일을 떠넘기는 것도 서슴지 않는군.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.src: All they do is sit up in that tower playing drinking games and act like they own this region!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.dst: 그놈들은 탑에 앉아서 술 게임이나 하면서 이 지역 주인인 양 굴어!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.src: I reported the fact there is clearly a Gert camp right in front of my house and they just ignored me! Now look, my pigs are all gone!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.dst: 우리 집 바로 앞에 Gert 야영지가 있다고 신고했는데 무시당했어! 이것 봐, 돼지가 다 없어졌잖아!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.src: I knew it was a mistake getting this property so close to gerten borders. See, gerts aren't the 'brutes' people insist, but...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.dst: Gerten 국경에 이렇게 가까운 땅을 산 게 실수였어. 사실 Gert는 사람들 말처럼 '짐승'은 아니지만...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.src: Well, they'll eat anything! Animals, fish, monsters, villagers, even humans! Biologically, they're just constantly hungry.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.dst: 뭐든 먹어! 동물, 물고기, 몬스터, 주민, 인간까지! 생물학적으로 늘 배가 고픈 거야.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.src: The watch is meant to keep them behind their borders...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.dst: 경비대가 원래 놈들을 국경 안에 묶어 둬야 하는데...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.src: I even bought a golem to watch over them - Got it for a good price because of some incident down at the {p} factory.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.dst: 감시하라고 골렘까지 샀어. {p} 공장에서 무슨 사고가 있어서 싸게 샀지.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.src: But somehow the gerts are managing to avoid it! Look, if you're here from the watch, could you help me out?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.dst: 그런데 Gert들이 어떻게든 골렘을 피해 다녀! 이봐, 경비대에서 왔으면 좀 도와줄래?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.src: Go to the gert camp west of here and find out how they are doing all of this!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.dst: 여기서 서쪽 Gert 야영지에 가서 놈들이 어떻게 이러는지 알아내 줘!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.src: Inspect the Gerten Forwarding Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#026.src: Investigate the cave in the back of the camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#026.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.src: -Good job to all of you! I am proud to say we made the cave road very well.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.dst: -모두 잘했다! 우리 동굴 길 아주 잘 만들었다고 자랑스럽게 말한다.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.src: The town folk at Gylia steal the stuff meant for us for their party, and leave us high and dry!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.dst: Gylia 마을 사람들 우리 줄 물건 훔쳐서 파티한다. 우리는 쫄쫄 굶는다!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.src: But those dumb over fed town folk did not catch us when we dug our cave road right under their watch house.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.dst: 하지만 멍청하고 배부른 마을 사람들, 우리가 감시 집 바로 밑으로 동굴 길 팔 때 못 잡았다.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.src: With our new way to get to Gylia land we have more stuff than ever!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.dst: Gylia 땅 가는 새 길 생겨서 우리 물건 어느 때보다 많다!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.src: Human! You're back... and haven't been eaten by a Gert!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.src: What did you discover in the camp?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.src: A tunnel?! Past Gerten borders? That must be how they're managing to get in and steal my livestock.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.dst: 터널?! Gerten 국경 너머로? 그걸로 들어와서 내 가축을 훔쳐 간 게 분명해.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.src: Look, human. The Watch aren't gonna do anything about this. Please... maybe you can help me.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.dst: 이봐, 인간. 경비대는 이 일에 손 하나 까딱 안 할 거야. 제발... 네가 도와줄 수 있을지도 몰라.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.src: If you can disguise yourself as a Gert maybe you could sneak into their main camp and check out this tunnel?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.dst: Gert로 변장하면 놈들 본 야영지에 몰래 들어가서 그 터널을 살펴볼 수 있지 않을까?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.src: Okay! As you can see, all Gerts wear a carved pumpkin on their head - something to do with their culture.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.dst: 좋아! 보다시피 Gert는 다 머리에 조각한 호박을 써. 놈들 문화랑 관련 있는 거겠지.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.src: There's a pumpkin farm near here at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]... maybe you could get one from there?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.dst: 근처 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에 호박 농장이 있어... 거기서 하나 구해 볼래?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#040.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.src: Go to the gerten pumpkin farm at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#041.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#042.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.src: Oh good, were you sent here to be my lunch?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.dst: 오 좋다, 너 내 점심 되라고 보내졌냐?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#043.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.src: Are you here to be my lunch?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#044.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#045.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.src: Oh. What are you then, some kind of snack?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.dst: 오. 그럼 넌 뭐냐, 간식 같은 거?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#046.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.src: ... Is that a joke? What are you, some kind of snack?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.dst: ... 그거 농담이냐? 넌 뭐냐, 간식 같은 거?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#047.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.src: A who.. man? Oh, you mean new folk! All the way here in gerten lands? I have not seen one of you here.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.dst: 인... 간? 아, 새 사람 말이구나! Gerten 땅까지 왔다고? 여기서 너희 같은 거 본 적 없다.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#048.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.src: I do want to know how you taste...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.dst: 너 무슨 맛인지 정말 알고 싶다...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#049.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.src: Doing? I am here to guard the orange gourd farm, of course!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.dst: 뭐 하냐고? 당연히 주황 박 농장 지키지!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#050.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.src: This farm right here is where all the gerts get their day mask from!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.dst: 여기 이 농장에서 모든 Gert가 하루 가면 얻는다!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#051.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.src: No, new folk. Gerts only in this farm.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.dst: 안 된다, 새 사람. 이 농장엔 Gert만.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#052.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.src: That is why I am put here. To make sure no one gets in.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.dst: 그래서 나 여기 있다. 아무도 못 들어가게.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#053.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.src: But but I get so bored... and I really want to eat...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.dst: 근데 근데 너무 심심하다... 그리고 정말 먹고 싶다...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#054.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.src: Like, with the clear green rocks?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#055.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.src: No new folk, gerts do not have any need for green rocks. But...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.dst: 아니다 새 사람, Gert는 초록 돌 필요 없다. 근데...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#056.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.src: How about this - I will just eat you!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#057.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#058.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#058.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#059.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#059.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.src: Well, I think I will still eat you. Just how it is!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.dst: 음, 그래도 널 먹을 거다. 원래 그렇다!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#060.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.src: Oh, it is a thing gerts have been doing for as long as we know.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.dst: 오, 그건 Gert가 우리 기억하는 옛날부터 해 온 거다.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#061.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.src: At wake time each day a gert takes an orange gourd and eats into it a shape that shows their mood!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.dst: 매일 깨는 시간에 Gert는 주황 박 하나 들고 기분 보여 주는 모양으로 파먹는다!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#062.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.src: It is really nice, is it not?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#063.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.src: We all want to eat all the time!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#064.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#065.speaker: Gert Guard

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#066.src: Oh... goodbye. Come back soon? With some food?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#066.dst: 오... 잘 가. 곧 다시 와? 먹을 거 들고?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#066.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
